digest.component_or_area: store git operations and local locking
propositions: Local git call sites in rebar are unbounded and lack contention policy, causing failures when multiple agents contend on shared store locks (.git/index.lock, ref locks) without automatic recovery.

Transient lock conflicts from concurrent local git operations should resolve silently through bounded jittered retry/backoff on the store's git call sites, consistent with existing push-retry patterns.

A per-store advisory lock plus bounded jittered retry on git's own lock signatures will serialize concurrent writers and absorb transient conflicts, surfacing only genuinely stuck locks with actionable error guidance.

Each local-only git call site must be explicitly bounded with a watchdog timeout justified against local latency (tens of seconds for plumbing, higher for slow walks) to prevent hung mounts from stalling the fleet.
